summary: Phase 3 testing of 9434-3977 QC inc. (Commandité) — new features: import-model, invoices (AR), bills (AP with file upload), sequential entry numbering per year, auto closing entry, Bilan/PNL PDFs, external catalog extended. 25/25 new backend pytests PASS + 21/21 phase-2 tests still PASS. Frontend Playwright validated: 8 tabs (entries/ar/ap/tb/bilan/pnl/accounts/external), sequential N° column in journal (2026-0001…), Facture client dialog with live TPS/TVQ/TOTAL (1000 HT → 1149,75), invoice creation and appearance in table, Facture fournisseur dialog with expense-account dropdown and totals, 5 doc-type checkboxes in external contacts (bilan_pdf/pnl_pdf/trial_balance/bilan/pnl), Bilan balanced badge. Backend acceptance criteria confirmed: import-model produced pnl 2026 net cur=-18.11 / prev=10000, bilan balanced, 2025 locked with closing entry, catalog contains 5 keys, seq num AAAA-000N, reports exclude source=closing, locked-year 403 on invoice+bill, PDF endpoints return %PDF, file endpoint requires auth (401 without token, 200 with ?auth= JWT). Object storage upload via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY works.

issues: Minor: React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — caused by the visual-editor injection layer wrapping option children in a <span>. Cosmetic console warning only, dropdown functions correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: qc_bill_file endpoint accepts token via ?auth= query param — necessary for / tag file preview in browser. Token is verified via JWT decode; acceptable but consider adding token-type check (only access tokens) to prevent refresh-token misuse.
_qc_post_closing computes P&L balances by iterating all non-closing entries of year and posting a single balancing entry to BNR (330010). Verified balanced. Deleting closing on unlock is idempotent.
qc_import_model guards on any existing years or entries (400). Non-idempotent by design (single-shot bootstrap). OK.
server.py is now ~5589 lines — the qc9434 block alone (~1200 lines) should be moved to its own module (backend/qc9434.py) similar to acct_ai.
Object-storage error handling: upload failure raises 400 but does not fall back to inline storage — acceptable, but consider capturing storage failures more gracefully in UI.
seed_data_creation: Phase-3 tests created TEST_ invoices/bills, then cleared. Per instruction, all qc9434_years / _entries / _settings / _invoices / _bills / _files collections were WIPED at the end (accounts left intact for re-seed on next GET). Main agent should re-run POST /api/qc9434/import-model to restore the clean model state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Data was purged at end of iteration; on next run either import-model or accept an empty qc9434 module. test_qc9434_phase3.py assumes the model has been imported (2025 locked + 2026 with 9 entries + active_year=2026). If not, run POST /api/qc9434/import-model as admin before executing. All tests idempotent w.r.t. lock/unlock cycle (last test locks then unlocks 2026).
